rows.jp: つくづく、きつい美人の典型。
rows.en: She really was the very model of a forbidding beauty.

ghs.en: She's the archetype of the harsh pretty girl, through and through.

rows.jp: 今話すのはやめておこう。
rows.en: Better not try talking to her now.

ghs.en: I'll let the conversation drop here.

rows.en: “Guess I’ll head up to the roof.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I guess I'll juuust go to the rooftop."
I went to leave the classroom,

rows.jp: 間際、視線を感じて振り返ると、目があった。
rows.en: At the door, I felt her watching me. I turned, and our eyes met.

ghs.en: but at the very last moment, feeling a gaze on my back, I turn around to meet her eyes.

rows.jp: 慌てて転じた視線が、投げやりに外に放り出される。
rows.en: Her gaze whipped away in panic and flung itself out the window with studied indifference.

ghs.en: The gaze is turned around in a panic and carelessly thrown back towards the outside.

rows.jp: ことさら指摘することはあるまい。
rows.en: I saw no reason to point it out.

ghs.en: There may not be anything to point out explicitly, perhaps.

rows.jp: そっと扉を閉めて、廊下に出た。
rows.en: I closed the door softly behind me and stepped into the hall.

ghs.en: Quietly closing the door, I left for the corridor.
